sam: Quick check — metering change for "Growth v2" packaging going live next week. Who is owning quota interlock and contract constraints? need to confirm billing event names and `quota_unit` mapping. cc @elaine @prateek

elaine: I can take billing adapter. Need the event list + mapping by EOD Wed. Do we have canonical names? https://redwood.corp/docs/metering/events

prateek: I'll own quota enforcement + contract constraints parity. Are we keeping existing ratecard thresholds or changing to v2? If v2, need migration window.

sam: v2 thresholds, yes. migration plan: 2-week gradual ramp. Need gap analysis from infra on telemetry and from billing on backfill.

dana: infra: telemetry is missing "quota_renewal" event for some legacy paths. PR created: #4892. ETA for rollout staging -> Fri. (reaction: :eyes:)

prateek: noted. can you paste the log format we expect? small snippet so billing knows parsing.

dana: sure:
```json
{"event":"quota_renewal","account_id":"acct_123","plan":"growth_v2","timestamp":1690000000,"tokens_used":0}
```

elaine: billing needs the `tokens_used` field to be int and `plan` to match ratecard keys exactly (case-sensitive). Also we need `contract_id` for enterprise accounts.

sam: OK — action list:
- dana: finish PR #4892 + staging rollout (ETA Fri)
- prateek: implement constraint checks + migration flags (ETA Tue)
- elaine: adapter changes + parsing tests (ETA Wed EOD)
- sam: coordinate canary and customer comms

prateek: I'll open PR for constraint checks today, will include unit tests and an opt-in flag: `--enable-v2-quota` for rollout.

sam: if billing needs backfill, please indicate required data retention window. @elaine

elaine: we'll need 90 days of token histories for safe backfill. If infra can't provide, we'll do a partial backfill for high-value contracts.

dana: infra can retain 90 days but needs explicit export request. I'll add to PR description and ping storage team.

sam: cool. small checklist for docs + contract constraints: anything blocking legal signoff?

prateek: legal asked for a short doc with failure modes and customer-visible throttling behavior. I'll draft and tag @elaine for signoff.

buildbot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout for PR #4892 at 2025-11-07T18:00Z. (automated)

sam: thanks. If anything changes, drop updates here. planning quick sync Tue 10am if still on track. :calendar:
